items.label: Stylish Retro Oval Sunglasses for Women
items.value: These small oval sunglasses feature a 90s inspired frame, blending Y2K aesthetic with modern minimalism. The small oval shape flatters petite faces and adds a timeless vintage vibe to any look - perfect for fashion lovers who adore retro-chic sunglasses.

items.label: Trendy & Fashion-Forward – Perfect Gift for Her
items.value: A must-have women’s fashion accessory, these trendy sunglasses pair effortlessly with jeans, dresses, or office wear. Ideal for wives, girlfriends, and fashionistas, they make a great gift for birthdays, anniversaries, or just because!

items.label: Lightweight & Comfortable for All-Day Wear
items.value: Made with durable yet featherlight PC frames and skin-friendly molded nose pads, these oval sunnies ensure all-day comfort - no pressure on your nose or temples. Perfect for driving, traveling, or daily errands!

items.label: 100% UV400 Protection - Safe & Clear Vision
items.value: The polycarbonate lenses block 100% UVA/UVB rays, protecting your eyes while keeping colors vibrant. Great for beach trips, sunny days, or outdoor adventures!

items.label: Versatile for Every Occasion - Dress Up or Down
items.value: From coffee dates to music festivals, these small-frame sunglasses elevate any outfit. Perfect for pool parties, bachelorette trips, concerts, weddings, or even just shopping. Whether for style or Instagram photos, these oval sunnies are your go-to accessory!

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Clean with a soft, dry cloth. Store in a protective case when not in use.
